On Android, open Phone Settings → Location → Location services → Timeline → Export Timeline data. Save Timeline.json, return here, then choose Open Timeline JSON.

The exact labels can vary by phone. The button below opens Location settings; Android does not provide a standard link directly to the Timeline page.

On iPhone, use Google Maps → profile picture → Settings → Personal content → Export Timeline data.
Choose a Timeline.json export to begin. Your location data stays on this device.
Location settings are unavailable on this phone
Turn your Google Maps Timeline export into a private animated travel film.
Animated map preview of the selected year
Private by design: the JSON stays on this device. CARTO receives tile requests for the map areas shown; no analytics or account is used.
